products.title: My Perfumes Leather of Men Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: My Perfumes Leather Of Men Eau de Parfum is a bold and rich leather fragrance made for men who like strong and deep scents. It opens with a slightly sweet and spicy mix of raspberry, saffron and thyme, which feels unique and attention grabbing. In the middle, jasmine adds a soft touch. In the base, leather, amber and suede create a warm, smoky and long lasting finish that feels masculine and powerful.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Eau de Parfum is the French house's richest sandalwood statement, built around a Guerlain-exclusive tincture that comes across as creamy and liqueur-like rather than dry. Originally a 2014 Middle Eastern exclusive, now back under the Absolus Allegoria line with over 90% natural-origin ingredients. Warm, leathery, unapologetically dense. Not a casual reach. Best for formal evenings, cold-weather events, and nights that call for something heavy.

products.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Spicy Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Salvatore Ferragamo Spicy Leather Eau de Parfum is the Italian house's bid at a grown-up leather fragrance. It lands closer to polished suede than raw hide. The leather here is smooth and amber-forward, built without the harsh birch-tar bite that turns people off the category. Warm and structured, more boardroom than biker jacket. Best for autumn and winter evenings, formal dinners, and dates.

products.title: Niche Sandalwood Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three iconic interpretations of sandalwood — a smoky modern woody signature, a rich oud and leather creation, and a creamy aromatic sandalwood. Three miniatures that showcase the depth and versatility of one of perfumery’s most captivating woods.

Inside:

• Santal 33 is cardamom, iris, and violet over Australian sandalwood and cedarwood, settling into spicy, leathery, and musky notes — smoky, distinctive, and effortlessly sophisticated.

• Santal Royal is neroli and jasmine over peach, rose, and cinnamon, settling into sandalwood, leather, amber, oud, and musk — rich, mysterious, and luxuriously warm.

• Tam Dao is sandalwood, cedar, cypress, and coriander, creating a creamy woody composition with fresh, slightly spicy facets — smooth, serene, and refined.

Three niche sandalwood icons, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your favorite expression of this timeless wood.

products.title: Chopard Rose Malaki Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Rose Malaki Eau de Parfum is the Swiss house's take on Middle Eastern rose, built around just three official notes: saffron, Damask rose, and Atlas cedar. The simplicity is misleading. Wear it for an hour and leather, cardamom, and something close to vanilla suede start surfacing underneath. More brooding than pretty, more resinous than fresh. Built for autumn evenings and anything that calls for a little gravity.

products.title: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Terre d'Hermes Eau de Toilette is the French house Hermès' definitive earthy masculine, and nearly two decades in, still the benchmark for the woody-mineral category. Jean-Claude Ellena built it without a single musk note, so it feels different on every skin rather than settling into a shared synthetic base. Dry, mineral, grounded. More cerebral than crowd-pleasing. Best for office days, formal settings, and autumn through spring.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Parfum
products.body_html: L'Homme Ideal Parfum is Guerlain's sharpest rewrite of its own flagship line. Perfumer Delphine Jelk rebuilt the signature almond around amaretto, pushing it woody and bitter where the EDP and Extrême flankers leaned sweet and cherry-forward. Leather and patchouli sit underneath, dry and close to the skin. More intimate than loud. Best for cooler nights, dates, and anything after dark.

products.title: Hermes H24 Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hermès H24 Eau de Toilette is the French house's attempt to build a modern masculine around something no other fragrance has used: sclarene, a molecule that smells like a hot iron pressing damp wool. Christine Nagel designed it to feel metallic and green at once, which lands as brilliantly original on some wearers and clinical on others. Not safe. Not sweet. Built for warm-weather offices and daytime wear when bland is not the goal.

products.title: Calvin Klein Classics Discovery Set
products.body_html:
Discover three iconic Calvin Klein fragrances in one curated sample set. From fresh and clean citrus to aromatic woods and warm, spicy sweetness, this trio brings together different sides of the brand’s classic fragrance style.

Inside:

  • Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette – A classic aromatic fragrance with fresh citrus, herbal notes and a smooth woody base. Clean, masculine and timeless.
  • Calvin Klein CK One – A fresh unisex fragrance with bright citrus, green tea and soft woody-musky notes. Crisp, clean and easy to wear.
  • Calvin Klein CK One Shock – A warmer, sweeter take on the CK One style, blending spicy, aromatic and woody notes with a smooth amber-tonka base. Casual, modern and inviting.

Three Calvin Klein classics, three distinct styles — an easy way to experience the brand’s signature fragrances and find your everyday favorite.

products.title: Calvin Klein Eternity for Women Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Eternity for Women Eau de Parfum is the 1988 floral that turned a real love story into a fragrance. Sophia Grojsman composed it as a tribute to Calvin Klein's marriage, not a marketing brief, and that sincerity still comes through in the wear. Green and powdery, built around lily and sandalwood, more gentle than loud. Best for spring and autumn daytime, office days, and unhurried weekends.

products.title: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men is the aromatic fougère that helped define what "clean" smells like in men's fragrance. Released in 1990, it introduced a subtle aquatic edge to the classic lavender-and-herbs structure, a move that shaped an entire generation of designer masculines. Crisp without being thin, familiar without being boring. Built for daytime, office wear, and warm-weather weekends.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Suede Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nyla Suede Eau de Parfum is Arabiyat Prestige's take on the gourmand-leather crossover, composed by Quentin Roussel. The leather never leads. It waits in the base, letting coconut, caramel, and praline run warm and sweet before suede and sandalwood pull everything darker and drier. Sweet enough to draw people in, dry enough to keep them guessing. Built for autumn evenings and date nights.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Sugarcane Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sugarcane Vanilla Eau de Parfum is Arabiyat Prestige's fruity-gourmand take on BORNTOSTANDOUT's Sugar Addict. The original leans boozy and rum-heavy. This version swaps that darkness for juicy fruit and lactonic milkiness, landing the same caramelized vanilla hit in a lighter, non-boozy format. Sweet but wearable, not cloying. Best for cooler evenings, date nights, and casual outings when the temperature drops.

products.title: Mykonos Inferno Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Inferno Extrait de Parfum is a dual-reference take on Creed Absolu Aventus, built by the woody spicy house Mykonos with a twist most Aventus clones never attempt. The caramelized pineapple and spice core stays faithful, but the base borrows from Hacivat's earthy oakmoss, landing darker and grittier than either source. More nocturnal than celebratory. Best for autumn evenings, date nights, and anyone hunting a signature that doesn't smell like every other Aventus-adjacent bottle.

products.title: Mykonos Nautilus Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Nautilus Extrait de Parfum is a fruity floral take on Ex Nihilo's Blue Talisman, from the Sunforged Collection. The Extrait concentration and added Ambroxan in the base make it warmer and longer-lasting than the original EDP. Bright and easy without going sheer. Built for spring and summer daytime, office wear, and warm-weather hours when something light still needs to last.

products.title: Mykonos Marbella Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Marbella Extrait de Parfum is the Indonesian house Mykonos proving that warm-weather gourmands don't need a European price tag. Tropical fruit and frangipani up front, drying down into a vanilla-benzoin base that lasts six to eight hours. Sweet and sun-baked, not dessert-counter. Built for beach days, summer dinners, and any warm-weather occasion where holding through the heat matters.

products.title: Nusuk Essentials Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three distinctive Nusuk creations — a dark spicy oud, a crisp citrus-aquatic freshie, and a rich rose-oud signature. Three miniatures that showcase the diverse character of Nusuk, from effortless freshness to deep Middle Eastern warmth.

Inside:

• Agar Noir Intense Parfum is chestnut, cognac, saffron, and labdanum over sage, cinnamon, and birch tar, settling into smoke, praline, sandalwood, and oud — smoky, warm, and intensely captivating.

• Sama is lemon and bergamot over ozonic notes, sage, and geranium, settling into moss, musk, and mineral amber — fresh, airy, and effortlessly clean.

• Al Mukhtalif Signature is oud, rose, sandalwood, amber, bergamot, neroli, and jasmine over agarwood, patchouli, cedar, lemon, and rose, settling into oud, musk, and vanilla — rich, woody, and luxuriously smooth.

Three Nusuk essentials, one exceptional set — the perfect way to experience three distinctive sides of the house.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Spiky Muse Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Spiky Muse Eau de Parfum is Ex Nihilo's 2025 entry into fruity-floral territory, built around a strawberry note that smells picked, not candied. The strawberry is upcycled Orpur extract, greener and more tart than the synthetic versions flooding the market. Rose sits underneath, honeyed and slightly spicy, grounded by pistachio and cedarwood. Bright enough for warm Indian evenings, light enough for daytime.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Speed Legends Night Drive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Speed Legends Night Drive is Ex Nihilo's after-dark rework of the original Speed Legends. Where that one ran bright on mandarin, Night Drive opens on ginger and sage, then drops into labdanum and patchouli. The finish is smoky and resinous, somewhere the original never goes. More brooding than flashy. Built for cool-weather evenings, date nights, and anything formal after sunset.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Oud Cadenza Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Oud Cadenza Extrait de Parfum is Maison Crivelli's densest release to date, a gourmand-woody built around real oud, dates, and cacao butter at 32% oil concentration. Every key ingredient carries ORPUR natural certification, from the Indian cardamom to the Madagascar vanilla. Rich and dark but not syrupy. Layered without being loud. Best for cooler evenings, formal dinners, and close-proximity wear.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Blue Talisman Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Blue Talisman Extrait de Parfum is Ex Nihilo's richer, more floral reworking of their original Blue Talisman. Concentrated at 30%, this is not just the EDT turned up. Jordi Fernández shifted the balance toward pear and jasmine sambac, pulling it away from the citrus-and-woods lean of the earlier version. Softer on skin than the original, but denser. Built for autumn evenings, dinners, and theatre.

products.title: Creed Oud Zarian Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Oud Zarian Eau de Parfum is the French house's first full commitment to oud as a lead material, not a background note. The oud is 80-year-aged Jalali sourced from Bangladesh's Sylhet forests, one of the rarest raw materials in any mainstream designer release. Dense, resinous, and polarizing. Some will find it too heavy, too old-world. Best for cold evenings and formal settings where restraint is optional.

products.title: Tom Ford Figue Érotique Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Figue Érotique is Tom Ford's first dedicated fig fragrance in the Private Blend lineup. Built around a bespoke Kadota fig accord, it leans milky and resinous rather than jammy. More sensual than fresh, with a salty sweetness that sits between green and ripe. Best for spring and summer evenings, date nights, and anywhere warmth pulls the fig out of the skin.

products.title: Vilhelm Parfumerie Mango Skin Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mango Skin Eau de Parfum is the fragrance that earned Stockholm-based Vilhelm Parfumerie a cult following outside niche circles. Ripe mango and blackberry dominate the opening, but the patchouli base is so understated most wearers never notice it. It quietly holds everything together. Fruity and sweet without tipping into candy. Built for warm-weather days, casual outings, and unhurried evening dates.

• Tiramisu Caramel is caramel over woody notes, coumarin, and honey, settling into vanilla, whiskey, and musk — warm, smooth, and decadently sweet.

  • Karus Blu Spice – A fresh, spicy fragrance combining citrusy brightness with aromatic and woody nuances. Energetic, modern and easy to wear.
  • Aqua Dubai – A vibrant fragrance with fresh citrus, fruity and aquatic touches balanced by warm woods. Crisp, smooth and contemporary.

Three fresh and sophisticated creations in one set — a great way to explore Imagination-inspired fragrances and find your favorite before committing to a full bottle.

  • YSL Raw Bourbon – A smooth, warm fragrance inspired by bourbon, blending woody and subtly sweet facets for a rich, enveloping feel. Elegant, sensual and distinctive.
  • YSL Velours Flamboyant Rose – A luxurious rose fragrance with a soft, velvety floral character and elegant depth. Refined, expressive and beautifully polished.

Three sophisticated creations from YSL’s Le Vestiaire collection — an ideal way to explore its distinctive fragrance style before choosing a full bottle.

products.title: Soft Florals Discovery Set
products.body_html:

Three soft floral signatures, one beautiful set — the perfect way to discover your next feminine favorite.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum is the oriental spicy flanker that leans hardest into warmth across the entire SWY lineup. A Sephora Middle East exclusive, it's one of the harder bottles to find outside the region. Saffron and cinnamon run through the middle, backed by dates and bourbon vanilla that feel dense without turning cloying. More intimate than loud. Built for autumn evenings, winter date nights, and any occasion where proximity matters.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Velours Flamboyant Rose Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Velours Flamboyant Rose is Yves Saint Laurent's latest floral chypre, built around a proprietary Damascena rose ingredient harvested at dawn in Grasse. Processing keeps it greener and more transparent than standard rose extracts. More dewy garden than perfume counter. Elegant without being heavy, textured without being loud. Best for autumn and winter evenings when something romantic but grounded fits the mood.

products.title: Riiffs La Matière Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs La Matière Extrait de Parfum is one of the more unusual picks in Riiffs' budget lineup. The chestnut opening comes across as roasted and slightly smoky, a long way from the citrus-aquatic openers that crowd this price tier. Warm and herbal through the middle, gourmand without tipping into sweet. Best for autumn and winter evenings, cooler Indian nights, and anything indoors after dark.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Blanc Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Pure Musc Blanc Eau de Parfum Intense is the latest addition to Narciso Rodriguez's iconic For Her musc line, pushing the signature musk brighter rather than louder. Perfumer Sonia Constant paired dual cedar notes, one dry and one creamy, to amplify radiance without adding weight. Clean and floral, but never sheer. Built for all-day wear in cooler months or air-conditioned offices where that white-musk glow holds steady.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Nude is the latest entry in the house's long-running musk series, and possibly its most personal. Perfumer Sonia Constant built the musk accords to react with skin chemistry, so the fragrance smells different on every wearer. Quiet, close to the body, more cosy than showy. Best for office days, casual outings, and cooler months when soft warmth lands right.

products.title: Nishane Meant To Be Seen Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Meant To Be Seen Extrait de Parfum is Nishane's entry into the iris-forward category, and it gets there differently than most. Civettone at the core adds a quiet animalic pulse that keeps the orris from going cold or powdery. Iris that feels warm and worn-in, not stiff. More skin scent than something you wear to fill a room. Built for office days, cool evenings, and anyone who wants to be noticed only up close.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Musc Nurāsana Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Crivelli Musc Nurāsana Extrait de Parfum is the French niche house's first fragrance built entirely around ORPUR-certified naturals. All five key materials come from the top 1% of Givaudan's traceability standard. The rose and frankincense sit bright and resinous, closer to morning light than evening smoke. Clean but textured, warm but never drowsy. Best for spring and summer mornings.

products.title: Al Majed Oud Boisée Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Majed Oud Boisée Extrait de Parfum is the Saudi house's attempt at building an oriental woody fragrance with European structure, and it lands. Incense and leather run through the core, but the finish is dry and architectural, not sweet. More French woody chypre than traditional Gulf oud. Not warm and cozy. Cold, formal, deliberate. Built for winter evenings and air-conditioned black-tie rooms.

products.title: Rayhaan Pacific Aloha Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pacific Aloha is Rayhaan's take on Room 1015's cult-favorite Wavechild. The candied watermelon accord runs on the same calone-ethyl maltol backbone as the niche original, landing an almost structural match at a fraction of the cost. Fruity and marine without tipping into sunscreen territory. More beach bonfire than poolside cocktail. Built for summer days, holidays, and anything outdoors.

products.title: Afnan Lynked Forever Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Lynked Forever Eau de Parfum is one of the rare budget releases from Afnan's Middle Eastern lineup that carries a serious pedigree. It was formulated by Jean-Louis Sieuzac, the perfumer behind Dior Fahrenheit and YSL Kouros. A creamy floral built on tuberose and coconut-laced sandalwood. Soft but structured, mature without feeling dated. A quiet year-round signature for women who prefer depth over sweetness.

products.title: Rayhaan Pacific Aura Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pacific Aura is the mintiest take on Louis Vuitton Pacific Chill in the clone market right now. Where rivals like Afnan Rare Reef lean warmer, this one doubles down on the mojito-like cooling that made the original popular. From Rayhaan's aromatic aquatic lineup, it stays crisp and green without drifting into synthetic territory. Built for Indian summers, outdoor plans, and anything before sundown.

products.title: Rayhaan Kiss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Kiss Eau de Parfum is a gourmand that smells edible in the best way, from Rayhaan's 2025 lineup. Berry and coconut open it, but the condensed milk note pushes into creamy, dairy-rich territory most fruity-sweet perfumes never reach. Polarizing for anyone who finds lactonic scents too heavy. Genuinely addictive for everyone else. Best for autumn evenings and date nights.

products.title: Rayhaan Tonquin Giza Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tonquin Giza is Rayhaan's oriental vanilla take on Guerlain's Tonka Sarrapia Extrait. Coumarin runs through both the heart and the tonka base, so the warmth never breaks. It just deepens as the fragrance settles. Rich but not syrupy, gourmand without tipping into dessert. Built for autumn and winter evenings, festive gatherings, and any date night worth dressing up for.

products.title: Al Majed Oud Prestige Ruby Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Majed Oud Prestige Ruby Eau de Parfum is a Middle Eastern take on Louis Vuitton's Stellar Times, at roughly one-tenth the price. The orange blossom and amber core stays faithful, but the sidr wood base adds a honeyed warmth the original doesn't carry. Most reviewers say it lasts longer and carries further than the LV. Works year-round, office to evening, without ever feeling out of place.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Discovery Set

Three Elizabeth Arden fragrances, three easygoing styles — a simple way to discover your favorite before committing to a full bottle.

Three Urban Man fragrances, three distinct moods — an easy way to explore the collection and find your favorite before committing to a full bottle.

  • Lattafa Angham – A warm, elegant blend with sweet, fruity and aromatic touches. Smooth, cozy and effortlessly inviting.
  • Lattafa Eclaire – A rich gourmand fragrance with a creamy, milky sweetness and warm vanilla character. Delicious, comforting and indulgent.
  • Lattafa Her Confession – A sophisticated fragrance combining soft florals, warm sweetness and deeper woody nuances. Feminine, sensual and refined.
  • Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa – A warm, spicy gourmand with coffee, cinnamon and sweet vanilla facets. Rich, cozy and especially appealing for evenings.

Five Lattafa favorites, five different moods — an easy way to compare the collection and discover which one deserves a full bottle.

Three Riiffs summer favorites, one refreshing set — the perfect way to discover your next warm-weather signature.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia Eau de Parfum is Armani's answer to the floral aquatic category. It still holds up fifteen years later. The citrus opening runs tart and specifically Mediterranean, closer to a lemon grove than a cleaning product. Fresh without being thin, sweet without tipping into gourmand. Best for spring and summer days, outdoor plans, and warm-weather travel where something light still needs to carry.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Eau Néroli Ambrée Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Narciso Eau Néroli Ambrée Eau de Toilette is Narciso Rodriguez's warm-weather edit of the heavier Ambrée EDP. The EDT strips back the coconut and thick musk, replacing them with fresh neroli and a lifted amber that smells more natural and less sweet. Reviewers consistently rate this version above the EDP for hot climates. Easy to wear, low-key in presence. Built for daytime, office, and anything under open sun.

products.title: Designer Fresh Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three iconic designer freshies built for everyday wear — clean citrus, aquatic freshness, and modern woody depth that work in every season.

Inside:

  • Sauvage EDP is fresh bergamot layered over ambroxan and smooth woods — bold, clean, and instantly recognizable.
  • Light Blue EDT is crisp citrus and Mediterranean freshness — airy, bright, and perfect for warm weather.
  • Cool Water Reborn is aromatic lavender and vetiver with a cool aquatic feel — refreshing, effortless, and easy to wear.

Three designer staples — fresh, versatile scents for office days, casual outings, travel, and summer heat.

Three office-ready classics, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your next signature scent.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahd Al Dhahab Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mahd Al Dhahab Extrait de Parfum is Arabiyat Prestige's take on BORNTOSTANDOUT's Drunk Lovers, built around the same boozy cognac-and-red-berry core with a spiced woody finish. This 2026 Extrait is a concentration upgrade over the 2025 EDP, packing a heavier fragrance load after the original drew complaints about lasting power. Warm and layered without tipping into gourmand territory. Best for autumn and winter evenings, date nights, and occasions worth dressing up for.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Extrait de Parfum is a faithful take on Louis Vuitton's Imagination, built from the same citrus-ginger-tea blueprint. The Extrait concentration pulls the bright opening inward fast, letting the dark tea and olibanum base show up earlier than expected. More resinous than lighter versions of this DNA. Quiet from a distance, stubborn on skin. Built for office days, formal settings, and long wear through spring and autumn.

products.title: Colour Me Sky Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Colour Me Sky Blue Eau de Parfum is a floral fruity release from Milton-Lloyd, a British house that quietly spends more on perfume oil concentration than on packaging or advertising. Community reviewers consistently note it smells well above its price point, with a bright freesia-and-peach opening that settles into a soft musky floral. Feminine without being sugary, light without disappearing. Best for daytime, office, and casual spring or summer outings.

products.title: Riiffs Freeze In Flames Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Freeze In Flames Extrait de Parfum is Riiffs' most unusual release to date, an aromatic fruity built around IFF's Raspberry and Passionfruit PulpXtract. These are whole-fruit extracts that smell closer to actual fruit than any synthetic reconstruction. The result is vivid and a little strange. Tart berry and passionfruit sit against cool spearmint and lavender. Polarizing on first spray. Built for spring and summer, daytime through late evening.

products.title: Maison Asrar Vanilla Voyage Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vanilla Voyage Eau de Parfum from Maison Asrar is a rich oriental vanilla built on the same DNA as Giardini di Toscana's Bianco Latte. The opening runs heavier on caramel and butter than the original, almost dessert-like, before settling into a softer milky vanilla after fifteen to twenty minutes. Gourmand without being juvenile, warm without being cloying. Best for autumn and winter evenings, date nights, and anywhere indoors where the heating is on.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum is the EDP upgrade to Elizabeth Arden's popular fresh floral line, built using Givaudan's VivaScentz technology. That's a formulation method designed to promote calm in the wearer, not just smell good. The tea-and-jasmine core stays clean without going soapy, grounded by a soft tonka-musk base. Quiet, steady, and genuinely easy to wear. Best for office days, warm-weather commutes, and winding down before bed.

products.title: Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum is Montblanc's sharpest pivot in the Legend lineup, trading the cool blue-grey freshness of earlier versions for a warmer, citrus-woody punch built around blood orange and cedar. Key ingredients were ethically sourced through LMR's traceable supply chain, rare for a designer EDP at this price. More versatile than loud. Built for office mornings that stretch into dinner.

products.title: Maison Asrar Vanilla Seduction Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vanilla Seduction Eau de Parfum from Maison Asrar is a fruitier, softer take on Kayali Vanilla 28. Where most alternatives go heavy and loud, this one opens with a tart plum note that keeps the vanilla grounded and wearable. More fruity gourmand than woody sweetness. Not the vanilla that fills a room. The one that pulls people closer. Best for cooler evenings and close-contact settings.

products.title: French Avenue Obsidian Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Obsidian Extrait de Parfum is French Avenue's take on By Kilian's Angel's Share On The Rocks. Most clones in this space lean purely boozy. Obsidian stacks a frosty citrus burst of grapefruit and bergamot over the cognac-cinnamon core. More year-round oriental woody than a winter-only gourmand. Evening and special occasions first, but the citrus opening pulls it comfortably into autumn.

products.title: Maison Asrar Vanilla Aura Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Asrar Vanilla Aura is an oriental vanilla built on the same DNA as Guerlain's Vanille Planifolia. The note list looks straightforward, but a quiet cinnamon warmth and a trace of wood smoke buried in the sandalwood give it unexpected weight. Rich without tipping into sugary, dark without feeling heavy. Best for autumn and winter evenings, date nights, and anything after sunset.

products.title: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum — an opulent floral-amber for women with bergamot, raspberry, rose damascena, oud and iris. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum — a crisp, fresh unisex classic with bergamot, green tea, blackcurrant and musk. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum — a fresh, saline fruity-marine unisex signature with bergamot, sea salt, iris and musk. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum — a timeless fresh-green classic with lemon verbena, violet leaf, iris and sandalwood. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum — a bold, fruity-chypre feminine signature with blackcurrant, rose, musk and sandalwood. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum – Official Vial (1.7 mL)
products.body_html: An official 1.7 mL travel spray vial of Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum — the iconic fruity-chypre signature (pineapple, birch, musk, oakmoss) from the House of Creed. Ideal for sampling, travel or on-the-go luxury.

products.title: Chanel Homme Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three iconic CHANEL creations for men — an intensely woody aromatic, a fresh sporty signature, and a creamy citrus-vanilla fragrance. Three miniatures that showcase the refined versatility of CHANEL before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Bleu de Chanel Parfum is lemon zest, bergamot, mint, and artemisia over lavender, pineapple, geranium, and green notes, settling into sandalwood, cedar, amberwood, and tonka bean — powerful, refined, and sophisticated.

• Allure Homme Sport Eau de Toilette is mandarin, sea notes, aldehydes, and blood mandarin over pepper, neroli, and cedar, settling into vanilla, tonka bean, white musk, amber, and vetiver — fresh, energetic, and effortlessly masculine.

• Allure Homme Edition Blanche is lemon and bergamot over pink pepper and aromatic notes, settling into sandalwood, vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, and musk — creamy, bright, and elegant.

Three CHANEL icons, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your next signature fragrance.

products.title: JPG Essentials Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three iconic Jean Paul Gaultier creations — a tropical woody scent, an elegant vanilla-amber fragrance, and the timeless fresh-aromatic Le Male. Three miniatures that showcase the unmistakable character of JPG before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Le Beau Le Parfum is pineapple, iris, ginger, and cypress over coconut and woody notes, settling into tonka bean, sandalwood, amber, and ambergris — tropical, creamy, and seductive.

• Le Male Le Parfum is cardamom over lavender and iris, settling into a rich vanilla base — warm, elegant, and irresistibly smooth.

• Le Male Eau de Toilette is fresh mint over comforting lavender, settling into sensual vanilla — clean, classic, and effortlessly masculine.

Three JPG essentials, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your next signature fragrance.

products.title: Al Wataniah Kayaan Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three distinctive creations from Al Wataniah’s Kayaan collection — a powdery iris and leather signature, a fresh citrusy woody scent, and a dark smoky leather fragrance. Three miniatures that showcase the different sides of Kayaan before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Kayaan Classic is Tuscan iris and Italian orange over rose and leather, settling into sandalwood, ambrette, agarwood, and cedar — powdery, smooth, and sophisticated.

• Kayaan Midnight is lemon, bergamot, mint, and artemisia over cedarwood, geranium, and green notes, settling into sandalwood and amber — fresh, refined, and mysterious.

• Kayaan Terra is incense and leather over myrrh and patchouli, settling into cedarwood and davana — smoky, earthy, and deeply captivating.

Three Kayaan signatures, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the collection’s distinctive character.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Mandarin Blossom Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Mandarin Blossom is the brightest, most citrus-forward entry in the White Tea line. Perfumer Gil Clavien built the mandarin-neroli top over an Ambroxan base. Most sheer citruses vanish in an hour. This one leaves a quiet, skin-close warmth that lingers. Light without being forgettable. Best for office mornings, weekend brunches, and anything outdoors in warm weather.

products.title: Mykonos California Blue Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos California Blue Extrait de Parfum is a fruity-aquatic take on Paco Rabanne's Invictus Parfum. Despite the Extrait concentration, it wears sweet and gummy rather than dense. More playful summer spray than heavy hitter. More approachable than intense, more casual than occasion-driven. Built for warm-weather daytime wear, outdoors, errands, and weekends.

products.title: Mykonos Inception Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Inception Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, citrus-forward take on Louis Vuitton's Imagination, from the rising niche house Mykonos. The shared bergamot-ginger-neroli structure is there, but Inception swaps the original's clean simplicity for a base built on Lorenox, a modern woody-amber molecule that lands smoother and cleaner without extra weight. Bright without going thin, structured without going stiff. Built for warm Indian days, office mornings, and easy weekend wear.

products.title: Essential Parfums Bois Impérial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Bois Impérial Eau de Parfum is the fragrance that turned Essential Parfums from a quiet Parisian label into a niche talking point. The woody backbone comes from Akigalawood, a sustainable ingredient upcycled from patchouli byproducts, not traditional timber. Aromatic and peppery up front, clean and grounded underneath. More quiet confidence than loud statement. Built for office, daytime, and warm-weather months where heavier woods fall apart.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: La Belle Paradise Garden is Jean Paul Gaultier's permanent addition to the La Belle line, built around blue lotus, iris, and vanilla in a floral aquatic direction. It's the same formula as the limited-edition La Belle Fleur Terrible from 2022, just renamed. Buyers who missed that run now have a standing option. Soft and slightly sweet, never heavy. Best for spring and summer daytime, warm-weather casual wear.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Splendor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Splendor Eau de Parfum is the late-'90s oriental floral that punches far above its price point. It's built around a lily-of-the-valley heart so dominant it survives scrubbing. Feminine and green-floral, but with real staying power most budget florals can't match. Best for spring and summer daytime, office wear, and everyday casual use.

products.title: Mykonos Aphrodite Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Aphrodite Extrait de Parfum is Mykonos' oriental vanilla take on By Kilian's Angel's Share. Where Angel's Share leads with boozy cinnamon sweetness, Aphrodite grounds itself in myrrh. Myrrh is one of perfumery's oldest ingredients, giving the spice real depth instead of dessert-like warmth. Rich and resinous more than sugary. Built for cooler evenings, date nights, and any formal occasion worth dressing up for.

products.title: Mykonos Utopia Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Utopia Extrait de Parfum is the Greek house Mykonos' take on Narciso Rodriguez For Her, built around the same powdery musk-and-floral structure but pushed into extrait concentration. Orris anchors the heart, giving it a luminous, expensive-smelling quality rare at this price. Clean without being boring, soft without disappearing. Built for daily wear and office, even through Indian summers.

products.title: Mykonos Dreamscape Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Dreamscape Extrait de Parfum is the Greek house Mykonos' smoothed-out take on Stéphane Humbert Lucas 777's God of Fire. The original leans tart and angular with oud. Dreamscape drops both, swapping in praline sweetness and soft cedar for something far more wearable. Fruity and floral without tipping into gourmand territory. Built for warm-weather days, beach outings, and casual spring wear where approachable beats polarizing.

products.title: Mykonos Conquer Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Conquer Extrait de Parfum is Mykonos' take on YSL's MYSLF L'Absolu, built on the same ginger-cardamom spine and amber-vanilla base. The difference is orris in the heart, a note the original skips entirely. It adds a powdery iris depth that pulls Conquer away from straight-clone territory. Spicy and floral without leaning sweet. Best for date nights and cooler evenings through autumn and winter.

products.title: Mykonos Glitch Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Glitch Extrait de Parfum is a fruity woody take on Creed Aventus, from Mykonos' gaming-culture crossover line built with Indonesian e-athlete SetiawanAde. The charred pineapple and bergamot opening stays bright and clean where most Aventus clones go syrupy. More playful than corporate, more daytime than date night. Built for warm weather, everyday wear, and anyone who wants the Aventus DNA without the Aventus price.

products.title: Mykonos Bonfire Vanilla Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Bonfire Vanilla Extrait de Parfum is the Indonesian niche house Mykonos' take on Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille, built at extrait concentration where most competitors stop at EDP. The smoky-sweet backbone is there, but burnt brown sugar and marshmallow push it more dessert-forward than the original's tobacco leaf. Rich without being cloying, warm without being loud. Best for cold-weather evenings and date nights where subtlety isn't the point.

products.title: Dior Privée Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three distinctive Dior Privé creations — a rich rose oud, an intense red-fruit floral, and a vibrant spicy oud. Three miniatures that showcase the collection's luxurious and daring character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Oud Ispahan is rose and saffron over patchouli, settling into oud and woody accords — rich, opulent, and beautifully mysterious.

• Rouge Trafalgar Esprit de Parfum is pink pepper and ripe red fruits over Turkish and Bulgarian roses, settling into a gourmand fruity trail — vibrant, sensual, and irresistibly bold.

• Purple Oud is sweet orange and pink pepper over saffron and citrus accords, settling into oud wood and warm woody notes — sparkling, spicy, and confidently luxurious.

Three Dior Privé signatures, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the collection's most captivating creations.

products.title: Designer Fresh Icons Discovery Set
products.body_html:
Discover three iconic designer fragrances in one curated sample set. From fresh aquatic energy to bright citrus and bold aromatic woods, this collection brings together three popular scents made for versatile everyday wear.

Inside:

  • Versace Eros Eau de Toilette – A fresh, aromatic fragrance with mint, green apple, lemon, tonka bean and vanilla. Vibrant, youthful and confidently sweet.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette – A crisp citrus fragrance with lemon, apple, cedarwood and musk. Clean, refreshing and perfect for warm-weather wear.
  • Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum – A powerful aromatic fragrance with bergamot, Sichuan pepper, lavender, vanilla and ambroxan. Fresh, spicy and smooth with a deeper character.

A great way to compare three designer icons and find your favorite before investing in a full bottle.

products.title: Lattafa Fahad Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fahad Eau de Parfum is the most technically serious release from Lattafa's catalogue and the first to carry two Givaudan-trained perfumers on the label. The oriental fougère structure leans aromatic and resinous, with incense and patchouli underneath a bright pineapple-pepper opening. More composed than loud. Built for autumn and winter evenings, formal dinners, and anything that calls for a collar.

products.title: Azzaro Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Azzaro's boldest Wanted creations — a spicy caramel gourmand, a rich tobacco-woody fragrance, and an intense fruity leather elixir. Three miniatures that showcase the collection's magnetic character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Most Wanted Parfum is ginger and red ginger over woody accords, settling into bourbon vanilla — spicy, warm, and irresistibly smooth.

• Wanted by Night is cinnamon, mandarin, lavender, and lemon over fruity notes, incense, cumin, and cedar, settling into tobacco, vanilla, leather, and patchouli — warm, spicy, and seductively sophisticated.

• Forever Wanted Elixir is raspberry, green mandarin, and bergamot over cardamom, lavender, and clary sage, settling into leather, Wolfwood, and vetiver — fruity, powerful, and confidently magnetic.

Three Azzaro favorites, one irresistible set — the perfect way to discover the Wanted collection's most magnetic signatures.

products.title: Khadlaj Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Icon Eau de Parfum is the UAE house Khadlaj's take on Chanel Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif. Same bergamot-lavender opening, same incense-laced heart, but the base splits. Where the original goes sweeter and slightly floral, Icon skews drier. Suede pushes ahead of sandalwood for a leathery-woody finish some will prefer. More resinous than polished. Best for cooler evenings, from office hours into dinner.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Nautilus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Nautilus Eau de Parfum is Rasasi's woody aquatic take on Xerjoff's 40 Knots, built on saline mineral notes, ambergris, and sun-bleached driftwood. Unlike other Hawas flankers that lean fruity or sweet, Nautilus strips all of that out. No fruit, no gourmand, just coastal air over dry cedar and sand. Built for warm-weather daytime wear, outdoors more than indoors.

products.title: Rayhaan Nava Sol Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Nava Sol is Rayhaan's take on Byredo's Mojave Ghost, built on the same floral-woody-musk backbone with a twist up front. Sapodilla replaces the usual pear note, pulling the opening toward something tropical and less predictable. Soft without being forgettable, sweet without leaning gourmand. Best for daytime wear through spring and summer, office or otherwise.

products.title: Rayhaan Cedrus Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Cedrus Blanc Eau de Parfum is a faithful take on Carolina Herrera's Cedar Chic, from the ultra-exclusive Herrera Confidential line that retails near $400 and rarely stays in stock. It carries the same aldehydic brightness into a soft cedarwood-and-orange-blossom core, clean and close to skin. More quiet confidence than loud statement. Built for year-round office wear, especially in Indian professional settings where restraint wins.

products.title: Clinique Happy for Women Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Clinique Happy for Women Eau de Parfum is the late-nineties floral fruity that refused to be sweet when every other feminine on the shelf was drowning in sugar. Citrus and crisp florals, no syrup. It won a FiFi Award in its debut year and still holds up as a clean, bright daily wear. Best for spring and summer mornings, office desks, and weekends that don't need a heavy fragrance.

products.title: Clinique Happy for Men Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Clinique Happy for Men Eau de Toilette is the citrus aromatic that made Clinique a name in men's fragrance. The citrus feels luminous and transparent rather than sharp, a quality that came from an early overdose of a jasmine-derived molecule most houses hadn't thought to push that far. Light but not thin. Built for warm-weather daytime, office hours, and anything outdoors between March and September.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Blue is one of the most quietly competent budget fougères in men's fragrance. What most buyers don't know: it's made by the Lalique Group, the same house behind Lalique's own niche lineup, and that pedigree shows. Clean, herbal, slightly citrus-forward. More boardroom than bar. Built for daytime wear, office hours, and warm Indian afternoons where anything heavier would be too much.

products.title: Al Wataniah Kayaan Midnight Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Kayaan Midnight is Al Wataniah's aromatic woody take on Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif. The artemisia opening adds a bitter-herbal bite that most blue-fragrance clones skip entirely, sharpening the citrus past what the original does. Incense-forward in the base, more brooding than clean. Built for autumn evenings, formal dinners, and late office-to-dinner transitions.

products.title: Al Wataniah Kayaan Terra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Kayaan Terra Eau de Parfum is Al Wataniah's woody-spicy take on Hugo Boss Bottled Absolu. Incense and leather up front, myrrh and patchouli through the middle. The real difference is in the base. Davana adds a fruity, liqueur-like warmth the original never had, making the dry-down rounder and less peppery. More smoky than sharp. Built for autumn and winter evenings, formal dinners, and dates worth dressing up for.

products.title: Byredo Extrait Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Byredo's most intense perfume extracts — a smoky tobacco, a refined leather, and a decadent fruity oud. Three miniatures that showcase the house's darker, more luxurious character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Tobacco Mandarin is mandarin, coriander, and cumin over tobacco, leather, and labdanum, settling into olibanum, oud, and sandalwood — smoky, warm, and intriguingly luxurious.

• Cuir Sellier is cashmeran and black tea over leather and tobacco leaves, settling into birchwood and oakmoss — refined, dark, and effortlessly sophisticated.

• Rouge Chaotique is bergamot, blackcurrant, and saffron over plum and praline, settling into papyrus, patchouli, and oud — rich, sensual, and irresistibly decadent.

Three Byredo signatures, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the house's most intense and captivating creations.

products.title: Tom Ford Esoteric Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Tom Ford's distinctive creations — a mysterious floral oud, an enveloping vanilla amber, and a dark, seductive vanilla wood fragrance. Three miniatures that showcase the house's luxurious character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Oud Voyager is geranium and living red peony over floral oud, settling into cypriol, oud, and osmanthus — mysterious, woody, and beautifully captivating.

• Vanilla Sex is vanilla tincture and vanilla absolute over jasmine and orris, settling into sandalwood and animalic accords — creamy, sensual, and irresistibly smooth.

• Vanille Fatale is saffraleine and frangipani over coffee absolute, roasted barley, and mahogany wood, settling into vanilla resinoid — dark, seductive, and decadently warm.

Three Tom Ford signatures, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the house's most captivating creations.

products.title: Frederic Malle Exclusives Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Frédéric Malle's most luxurious creations — a powerful rose oud, a rich fruity oud, and an opulent rose chypre. Three miniatures that showcase the house's exceptional artistry before going full bottle.

Inside:

• The Night is Turkish rose and saffron over natural oud, settling into frankincense and sandalwood — dark, powerful, and exceptionally luxurious.

• The Moon is raspberry, lychee, and saffron over frankincense and Turkish rose, settling into oud and leather — fruity, opulent, and beautifully sensual.

• Portrait of a Lady is rose over blackcurrant, raspberry, and clove, settling into patchouli, sandalwood, and frankincense — dramatic, elegant, and unmistakably refined.

Three Frédéric Malle masterpieces, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the house's most captivating signatures.

products.title: Niche Leather Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three distinctive leather creations — a bold fruity leather, a warm spicy leather, and a wild saffron-infused leather. Three miniatures that showcase the depth and versatility of modern leather perfumery.

Inside:

• Tom Ford Tuscan Leather is saffron, raspberry, and thyme over olibanum, jasmine, and leather, settling into black suede and amberwood — bold, sensual, and unmistakably luxurious.

• Diptyque Eau Rihla is pink pepper and Atlas cedar over iris, raspberry, vanilla, and saffron, settling into a rich leather accord — warm, refined, and beautifully distinctive.

• Memo Paris African Leather is cardamom, geranium, and pink pepper over rose, patchouli, and cinnamon, settling into leather, oud, and amber — spicy, powerful, and effortlessly captivating.

Three exceptional leather signatures, one sophisticated set — the perfect way to explore the many facets of leather perfumery.

products.title: Byredo Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum is the oddball in Byredo's Night Veils collection, and deliberately so. It is the line's only oud gourmand, dropping saffron and praline into a heavy agarwood-patchouli base where every other Night Veil leans floral. Divisive on first spray, rewarding as it settles. Built for cold evenings, date nights, and occasions where playing it safe is not the point.

products.title: Byredo Cuir Sellier Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Cuir Sellier Extrait de Parfum is the Swedish niche house's most assertive leather to date. The black tea note is unusually persistent, threading through the entire wear alongside the leather rather than burning off in the first ten minutes. Dry, smoky, and unapologetically heavy. Not for the office. Built for cold evenings, formal dinners, and anyone who wants their fragrance to arrive before they do.

products.title: Frederic Malle The Night Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Night Eau de Parfum is Frederic Malle's most confrontational oud fragrance. Dominique Ropion built it around 21% natural Indian oud oil, a concentration almost unheard of in a spray EDP. Raw, animalic, and unapologetically heavy. This is not a safe reach for oud-curious buyers. It rewards people who already know they want the real thing. Best for cold evenings and occasions that call for presence.

products.title: Frederic Malle The Moon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Moon Eau de Parfum is Frederic Malle's most polarizing entry in their Desert Gems collection, and deliberately so. Julien Rasquinet built the red berry accord to smell like the fruity sweetness of a hookah lounge, not a French garden. Heavy oud and leather underneath, with a trail that announces itself before you arrive. Not subtle, not trying to be. Best for cold evenings and formal settings where restraint is optional.

products.title: Nishane Hacivat Oud Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nishane Hacivat Oud Extrait de Parfum is the final chapter of the Turkish house's Hacivat trilogy, and the only one built around real oud oil. Dominique Ropion kept the original's pineapple-pepper signature but buried it under frankincense and dark, animalic oud. Less fruity chypre, more resinous smoke. Not a crowd-pleaser, not trying to be. Built for cold evenings and occasions that call for weight.

products.title: Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Après l'Amour Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Après l'Amour is the Berlin-based house's most polarizing release. Built around an ambroxan-heavy molecular core, it pulls a strange trick. Nearly invisible on skin after ten minutes, but it fills entire rooms and clings to fabric for hours. A silent presence, not a loud one. Best for cooler evenings, date nights, and anyone who wants to be noticed before they speak.

products.title: Niche Rose Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set brings together three exceptional interpretations of rose — a rich ambery rose, a luxurious rose chypre, and a deep, sensual Persian rose. Three miniatures that showcase the elegance and complexity of niche rose perfumery.

Inside:

• Armani Privé Rose d'Arabie is saffron over Damascena rose, patchouli, and dark woods, settling into golden amber — opulent, sensual, and beautifully mysterious.

• Frédéric Malle Portrait of a Lady is rose over blackcurrant, raspberry, and clove, settling into patchouli, sandalwood, and frankincense — dramatic, elegant, and unmistakably luxurious.

• Guerlain Rose Amira is rose over frankincense and patchouli, settling into a soft halo of musk — deep, sensual, and beautifully refined.

Three extraordinary rose creations, one elegant set — the perfect way to explore three distinctive signatures of modern rose perfumery.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Marine Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Bvlgari Aqva Marine Pour Homme is the Italian house's most genuinely oceanic men's fragrance. The original Aqva stays clean and mineral. This flanker leans into actual saltwater, built around Posidonia Oceanica, a Mediterranean sea grass that adds a sunlit, briny edge. Bright but not synthetic. More coastal afternoon than department store aquatic. Best for beach days, outdoor weekends, and warm-weather office wear.

products.title: Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man Rain Essence is Bvlgari's attempt at a rain fragrance that skips the obvious. Alberto Morillas avoided petrichor entirely, building the wet-air impression through mineral amber, ozonic musk, and sheer guaiac wood. The result smells nothing like a typical blue or marine fragrance. Quiet, transparent, almost geological. Best for daytime office wear and casual spring or summer outings.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Noire Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Noire Absolu is Arabiyat Prestige's take on Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir, built on the same fruity-leather backbone but tuned sweeter and spicier with the leather dialed down. It comes across as more approachable than the original. More crowd-friendly gourmand than stiff leather. Warm without being cloying, easy without being boring. Best for date nights and cool-weather evenings.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Noire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Noiré Eau de Parfum is a faithful take on Dior Homme Intense from Arabiyat Prestige's oriental fougère lineup. Lucas Sieuzac smooths out the powdery, makeup-leaning iris and adds a subtle fruity lift, making this more season-flexible than the original. Less sharp, more rounded, with none of the synthetic edges that plague most clones. Built for date nights and cooler months, from autumn onward.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aristo Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Aristo Eau de Parfum is a faithful take on Goldfield & Banks' Ingenious Ginger, from the Middle Eastern house Arabiyat Prestige. Bright ginger and citrus up front, floral patchouli in the middle. Where the original fades to lean woods, Aristo lands on a creamy vanilla-sandalwood base. It wears warmer and softer. More versatile than sharp. Works for office mornings, casual weekends, and cooler evenings alike.

products.title: Riiffs Aswaar Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Aswaar Extrait de Parfum is Riiffs' take on Nishane Ani, built on the same ginger-citrus-vanilla backbone but pushed into a higher-oil Extrait concentration the original never offered. That extra density means eight to ten hours of wear, where Ani typically fades closer to seven. Bright and spicy up front, warm and resinous underneath. Works across seasons, but hits hardest on cool evenings.

products.title: French Avenue Ravine Ice Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Ravine Ice Extrait de Parfum is French Avenue's lean, citrus-aromatic take on Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Moss. Built with only eight ingredients, it strips the formula down to salt, moss, and bright lemon without losing structure. More minimal than sparse. Clean but never boring. Best for spring and summer daytime, from the office to a weekend lunch outdoors.

products.title: French Avenue Firestorm Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Firestorm Extrait de Parfum is French Avenue's oriental-floral take on Penhaligon's The World According to Arthur. Where the original leans incense-heavy, Firestorm opens on davana and red apple. A liqueur-soaked fruit accord that feels closer to dessert than cathedral. Resinous and sweet, but never cloying. Polarizing on first spray. Built for cooler evenings and occasions that call for something less predictable.

products.title: French Avenue Grow Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Grow Extrait de Parfum is French Avenue's oriental woody take on Guerlain's Tonka Sarrapia Extrait, composed by Jean-Christophe Hérault, the perfumer behind Creed Aventus and Spicebomb Extreme. One of the few times a perfumer at that level has worked with a Middle Eastern house at this price point. Rich, resinous, and unapologetically dense. Built for cool weather evenings, date nights, and occasions worth dressing up for.

products.title: French Avenue Mythical Gryphon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Mythical Gryphon is a spice-forward oriental from French Avenue's Middle Eastern lineup that punches well above its price. The heart runs on Akigalawood, a proprietary Givaudan molecule with dry, textured woodiness rarely seen in budget releases. Warm and layered without turning syrupy. Built for cooler evenings, formal dinners, and date nights where showing up quietly loud matters.

products.title: French Avenue Le Falcon Dubai Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Le Falcon Dubai Extrait de Parfum is a woody-spicy take on YSL's Babycat from French Avenue's Middle Eastern-inspired lineup. Where Babycat leans into vanilla-suede sweetness, Le Falcon swaps that for dry pepper and smoky incense-wood. It comes across as older and less sugary. Spicy without being harsh, dark without being dense. Best for evenings and date nights once the weather cools down.

products.title: Fragrance World Nuke 2.0 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nuke 2.0 Eau de Parfum is Fragrance World's spicy oriental take on Viktor & Rolf's Spicebomb Extreme. Clone forums rate it near-identical, and several reviewers call it equal or better than the original. It opens loud and settles into a warm, spicy-sweet trail that lasts all day. Built for cold weather and late nights, not daytime wear.

products.title: Fragrance World Genuine Man Giovany Reserve Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Genuine Man Giovany Reserve is Fragrance World's take on Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privée, built around the same iris-whiskey core. Give it time. Reviewers consistently note the opening smells tighter and more synthetic out of the box, but a few weeks of maceration rounds it out. More buttoned-up than brooding. Best for cooler evenings, formal dinners, and date nights.

products.title: Fragrance World Ador Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Ador Eau de Parfum is the Dubai-based house's take on Dior J'adore, built on the same bright floral-fruity base. Where J'adore stays clean and purely floral, Ador adds a dark blackberry-vanilla base that pushes it into warmer, slightly gourmand territory the original never touches. Feminine without being delicate, sweet without losing its flowers. Best for daytime, office hours, and casual spring-to-summer outings.

products.title: French Avenue Marmara Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Marmara Extrait de Parfum is French Avenue's woody-spicy take on Amouage Purpose 50. Saffron and black pepper open it, but the ambroxan-heavy heart pulls it in a cleaner, more mineral direction than the frankincense-driven original. That shift makes it easier to wear daily. More office-safe than dramatic. Built for cooler months, from morning meetings to late dinners.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Gold Digger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Gold Digger Eau de Parfum is the Dubai house Rasasi's take on Jean Paul Gaultier's Ultra Male. It mirrors the original's pear-lavender-cinnamon structure closely but softens the black vanilla and drops the caraway, landing a fresher, less gourmand finish. Sweet enough to turn heads, clean enough not to cloy. Built for cool-weather evenings, date nights, and anywhere proximity matters.

products.title: Bvlgari Men's Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has five of Bvlgari's most-loved men's fragrances — a woody-citrus city scent, a dark rum-and-tobacco statement, and three shades of the aquatic freshness the house is famous for. Five miniatures to find out which Bvlgari is yours before going full bottle.

Inside:

  • Wood Essence is fresh citrus over earthy green tones, settling into deep, smooth woods — a forest breeze in the middle of the city, grounded and quietly confident.
  • Man in Black is spice, sweet rum, and smoky tobacco over leather, iris, and tuberose, settling into tonka bean, guaiac wood, and benzoin — dark, bold, and unmistakably masculine.
  • Aqva is mandarin, orange, and petitgrain over seaweed, lavender, and cotton flower, settling into Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber — clean, oceanic, and effortlessly wearable.
  • Rain Essence is green tea and sparkling orange over white lotus and crystal musk, settling into mineral amber and guaiac wood — fresh, airy, and quietly luminous.
  • Aqva Marine is grapefruit, neroli, mandarin, and petitgrain over Posidonia seaweed and rosemary, settling into Virginia cedar and amber — bright, invigorating, and pure water.

Five Bvlgari classics, one refined set — the easiest way to find your signature from the house that defined modern aquatic perfumery.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Ajmal's most iconic Wisal creations — a fruity floral musk, a classic rose and musk fragrance, and a deep fruity oud composition. Three miniatures that showcase the collection's elegant character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Wisal Dahab is pear, apple, peach, grapefruit, and mandarin over rose, orchid, jasmine, and geranium, settling into sandalwood, musk, cedar, and patchouli — fruity, floral, and beautifully elegant.

• Wisal is fresh floral and fruity notes over rose and floral accords, settling into musk, sandalwood, and woody notes — classic, graceful, and effortlessly charming.

• Wisal Layl is apricot, blackcurrant, and freesia over rose, osmanthus, and patchouli, settling into oud, frankincense, and musk — rich, mysterious, and confidently luxurious.

Three Ajmal favorites, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover the Wisal collection's most distinctive signatures.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Carolina Herrera's most iconic Good Girl creations — a rich floral amber, the original seductive signature, and a vibrant fruity rose. Three miniatures that showcase the bold, feminine elegance of the Good Girl collection before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Good Girl Blush Elixir is bergamot and mandarin over ylang-ylang and rose, settling into vanilla, patchouli, and creamy cocoa accords — sensual, elegant, and irresistibly feminine.

• Good Girl is almond and coffee over jasmine sambac and tuberose, settling into tonka bean, cocoa, vanilla, sandalwood, and praline — rich, seductive, and timeless.

• Very Good Girl is red currant and litchi over rose, settling into vetiver and vanilla — bright, playful, and confidently glamorous.

Three Good Girl icons, one elegant set — the perfect way to discover your signature Carolina Herrera fragrance.

products.title: Lalique White in Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lalique White in Black Eau de Parfum is the French crystal house Lalique's take on Parfums de Marly Layton. The cardamom-lavender core and vanilla-ambroxan base follow a similar blueprint, but White in Black leans drier and more resinous. Olibanum and tolu balsam do that. Less sweet, more structured. Built for cool-weather evenings, date nights, and anywhere after dark.

products.title: Riiffs Hulm Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Hulm Extrait de Parfum is Riiffs' entry into soft feminine florals, built around peach nectar, rose, and peony. What separates it from the category is the Iso E Super base, a synthetic woody-amber molecule that gives it a diffusive glow and staying power most musk-heavy florals lack. Fruity without being sugary, floral without being powdery. Best for spring and summer mornings, office wear, and easy everyday use.

products.title: Riiffs Hoor Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Hoor Extrait de Parfum is Riiffs' take on Goldfield & Banks' Sunset Hour, built around the same rare quandong. That's an Australian desert peach note almost nobody outside niche Australian perfumery uses. Where the original leans tropical and sun-soaked, Hoor wraps that fruit in a thicker amber-vanilla base, pulling the whole thing toward evening. Warm without being syrupy, rich without being loud. Best for autumn nights, festive dinners, and cooler Indian evenings.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Good Girl Blush Elixir is Carolina Herrera's darker, richer rework of the original Good Girl Blush. A concentrated chypre-amber formula, the higher oil load means patchouli doesn't just sit underneath the florals. It actively reshapes them, pulling the rose-ylang heart into something moodier and less sweet. More nighttime than daytime. Best for date nights, autumn evenings, and cooler weather where the vanilla-patchouli base opens up properly.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum is the first fruit-forward flanker in Giorgio Armani's long-running SWY line. The cherry top note opens juicy and slightly boozy, a distinct departure from every other version before it. It then folds into the familiar chestnut-vanilla base the series is built on. Warmer and heavier than the original, not as sweet as Absolutely. Best for fall evenings and date nights when the temperature drops.

products.title: Refillable Atomiser – 8mL
products.body_html:
The Scentira Refillable Perfume Atomiser is an 8mL travel perfume spray bottle you fill from the bottle you already own. One fill holds 100+ sprays, about one to two weeks of daily wear, and the solid aluminium body carries in a pocket or bag without leaking. The opaque shell keeps sunlight off your fragrance, the inner bottle is drop-safe, and the fine-mist sprayer covers a pulse point in one press.

Filling takes seconds and wastes nothing. Pull the spray head off your perfume to expose the nozzle stem, press the atomiser down onto it a few times, and watch it fill. For decants, samples, or bottles with fixed heads, unscrew the inner bottle and pour straight in. It fits most perfume bottles, refills for years across every bottle you own, and at 8mL it sits well under cabin liquid limits. Available in Grey, Matte Black and Copper Brown.

Built for autumn and winter evenings, formal dinners, and business settings where subtlety wins.

products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Oud Al Layl is a woody floral take on Tom Ford's Arabian Wood, from the Middle Eastern house Arabiyat Prestige. The bottle holds two pieces of real agarwood floating inside the glass, a design move rare at this price. Rose and saffron up front, dense oud and amber underneath. Not subtle. Best for autumn nights, festive evenings, and occasions where restraint is optional.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Swar Serpentine Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Swar Serpentine is a faithful budget take on Stéphane Humbert Lucas 777's The Queen and the Viper, a $200+ niche release most people will never blind buy. From Arabiyat's oriental woody lineup, it pairs a minty-citrus opening with a dark tobacco-saffron-dates base that few houses attempt at this price. Polarizing, resinous, not remotely safe. Best for autumn evenings, date nights, and occasions that call for something heavier.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Marasi For Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Marasi For Her is a floral fruity gourmand take on Mugler's Angel Stellar, from Arabiyat Prestige's growing Middle Eastern lineup. Where the original leans pistachio-nutty, Marasi swaps in hazelnut and mango, pushing it toward a richer, tropical-gourmand direction. Sweet and dense, but not juvenile. Built for date nights, cool-weather evenings, and occasions where showing up soft and loud at the same time works.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Marasi For Him Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Marasi For Him is Arabiyat Prestige's oriental spicy take on Loewe Solo Elixir. It shares the lavender, olibanum, and cinnamon core but adds jasmine sambac up top and tarragon in the base. Both notes are absent from the original. The result is more floral at the start and more herbal at the finish. Built for autumn evenings, winter dinners, and formal settings after dark.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Swar D'Amour Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Swar D'Amour is a faithful take on Stéphane Humbert Lucas 777's Sea My Love, from Arabiyat Prestige's growing Middle Eastern lineup. It carries the same salty mandarin-and-leather pairing that costs north of $300 in the original, landed here under $50. More coastal than cologne, more suede than synthetic. Best for warm-weather days, outdoor plans, and early evenings where something unusual beats something safe.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Revolt Uncaged Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Revolt Uncaged is a woody-spicy take on Nishane Tero, from Arabiyat Prestige's growing Middle Eastern lineup. The salty-caramel opening sounds gourmand on paper, but dual peppers, Sichuan and black, keep it dry and almost savory. Warm without being sugary, grounded without going flat. Built for autumn and winter evenings, date nights, and anything after dark.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ramad Earthy Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ramad Earthy Extrait de Parfum is Arabiyat Prestige's oriental-spicy take on Amouage Sindbad, built on the same fruity-honeyed foundation but steered in a different direction. The cappuccino-and-tea heart is where it splits off, trading the original's smoother middle for dried-fruit incense and coffeehouse warmth. Divisive on first spray, rewarding with time. Best for autumn and winter evenings, date nights, and occasions worth dressing up for.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Bois Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Bois Blanc is a clean-woody oriental from Arabiyat Prestige's Middle Eastern lineup, built on the same DNA as Essential Parfums' Bois Impérial. The original leans on Akigalawood for its woody character. Bois Blanc gets there through traditional ambergris and patchouli instead. The result is quieter, more understated. Built for the office, any season, any weather.

• Pink Drops is raspberry, strawberry, and bergamot over rose, praline, and marshmallow, settling into vanilla, white musk, and sandalwood — sweet, playful, and irresistibly addictive.

• Cafe Drops is coffee, cardamom, and cinnamon over caramel, cocoa, and tonka bean, settling into vanilla, amber, and sandalwood — rich, creamy, and deliciously comforting.

• Coconut Dreams is coconut, bergamot, and tropical fruits over jasmine, tiare flower, and creamy accords, settling into vanilla, sandalwood, and white musk — smooth, tropical, and beautifully comforting.

Three gourmand favorites, one irresistible set — the perfect way to discover Mykonos' sweetest signatures.

products.title: Mykonos Sweet Escape Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Mykonos' most loved creations — a creamy tea-inspired gourmand, a vibrant tropical fruity scent, and a bold modern floral. Three miniatures that showcase the brand's playful yet luxurious character before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Matcha Latte is bergamot and green tea over matcha, jasmine, and creamy milk accords, settling into vanilla, sandalwood, and white musk — creamy, comforting, and irresistibly smooth.

• Hawaiian Crush is pineapple, mango, and citrus over coconut, tiare flower, and jasmine, settling into vanilla, musk, and sandalwood — juicy, tropical, and effortlessly uplifting.

• Stilettos is pink pepper and bergamot over rose, orange blossom, and jasmine, settling into vanilla, patchouli, and musk — elegant, feminine, and confidently glamorous.

Three Mykonos favorites, one irresistible set — the perfect way to discover your next signature fragrance.

products.title: Reef 33 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Reef 33 Eau de Parfum is the saffron oud fragrance from Reef Perfumes that several later releases quietly borrowed from. It's often considered as a smoother alternative of Imperial Valley by Gissah.

The saffron runs warm and resinous, not metallic. The oud stays woody rather than barnyardy. Dense but controlled, more formal than loud. Built for autumn and winter evenings, dinners, and occasions that call for presence.

products.title: French Avenue Zenith Deep Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Zenith Deep Extrait de Parfum splits the difference between Bleu de Chanel's EDP and Parfum in one bottle. The opening carries the Parfum's depth, but the dry down lands on the EDP's powdery, creamy incense finish. That duality is the selling point, and it works. Fits office, daily wear, and three-season rotation without feeling thin or overdone.
