products.title: Rasasi Hawas Atlantis Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Atlantis is the sharpest pivot in the Hawas lineup. Where original Hawas leans fruity-sweet with apple and plum, Atlantis strips that back for galbanum and raw mineral-salt, building a green-marine accord instead of the usual crowd-pleasing aquatic sweetness. Divisive on first spray, rewarding after an hour. Built for warm-weather daytime, outdoors to office.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas London Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas London Eau de Parfum is Rasasi's niche-leaning take on Ex Nihilo's Brompton Immortals Extrait. A sharp turn from the loud aquatic Hawas flankers, it trades calone and cardamom for saffron, frankincense, and blonde woods. The result feels closer to an extrait than a mainstream release. Restrained, incense-forward, and deliberately quiet. Built for autumn and winter evenings, office-to-dinner transitions, and anything that calls for a suit.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Viper Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Viper Eau de Parfum is Rasasi's darkest flanker and their closest swing at the earthy, cannabis-resinous territory of Nasomatto Black Afgano. Composed by Julien Rasquinet, it shares nothing with the aquatic-fruity Hawas line. Smoky, herbal, and tobacco-heavy, with a sweetness that stays buried. Not a crowd-pleaser. A deliberate choice. Best for autumn and winter evenings when safe isn't the point.

products.title: Riiffs Zenith Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Zenith Extrait de Parfum is the first Middle Eastern-priced take on Mind Games Queening, a US niche floral gourmand that retails above $300. Zenith lands the same creamy vanilla-coconut-orris profile at a fraction of the cost, in a 100ml size the original house doesn't even offer. Soft and powdery, closer to a skin scent than a room-filler. Best for cooler evenings, layering weather, and days when loud isn't the point.

products.title: Memo Paris African Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Memo Paris African Leather is the French house's most talked-about leather fragrance, one of the few that earns the word "bold" without faking it. The geranium is Egyptian-sourced, rooted in the same soil where the flower first grew wild. It feels geographic rather than decorative. Spicy and animalic, more campfire than boutique. Built for cold evenings, formal dinners, and nights that need presence.

products.title: Mykonos California Signature Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos California Signature Extrait de Parfum is an aromatic aquatic from the Indian house Mykonos, built on the same DNA as Bond No. 9 Lafayette Street. Lafayette Street leans on ambroxan and apple. This one swaps in lychee and aquatic notes for a softer, sweeter feel. Easier to wear, less polarizing, more forgiving in warm weather. Best for daytime, office, and casual wear through spring and summer.

products.title: Mykonos Stilettos Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Stilettos Eau de Parfum is one of the few EDP-concentration releases from Mykonos, a house that otherwise leans heavily into Extrait de Parfum. That makes it a lighter entry point into the lineup. It still lasts well past the eight-hour mark. Fruity and floral up front, warm and resinous underneath. More wearable than loud. Best for office days and cool-weather evenings indoors.

products.title: Mykonos Luminos Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Luminos Extrait de Parfum is the first fragrance from Mykonos built around a proprietary Blue Java Banana accord, a note no other house uses. The fruity-creamy opening rolls into a dense floral heart before settling into warm amber, cashmeran, and an ice cream accord that feels more cozy than sweet. Gourmand without being juvenile. Built for autumn and winter evenings, indoors or out, when cooler air lets the base open up fully.

products.title: Mykonos Coconut Dreams Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Coconut Dreams Extrait de Parfum is Mykonos' entry into the oriental vanilla gourmand space. It skips the sunscreen-tropical cliché entirely. A sweet rice note in the heart pulls the coconut toward soft, edible dessert territory. It stays close to skin rather than carrying across a room. Cozy without being cloying, quiet without disappearing. Best for autumn evenings, casual dinners, and cooler nights that call for warmth.

products.title: Mykonos Matcha Latte Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Matcha Latte Extrait de Parfum picks up where Maison Margiela's discontinued Matcha Meditation left off, then pushes it further. The Extrait concentration gives it a density the original never had, leaning harder into creamy, nutty warmth around that green-tea core. Soft enough for the office, cosy enough for a slow weekend at home. Built for autumn and winter daytime wear.

products.title: Mykonos Hawaiian Crush Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Hawaiian Crush Extrait de Parfum is the Dubai-based house's tropical gourmand built for actual heat. The tiare flower in the heart, a creamy Tahitian gardenia, keeps it from feeling like just another pineapple-coconut splash. Lush and warm without tipping into syrupy. Best for beach days, outdoor brunches, and any summer plan where the sun does most of the work.

products.title: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Tobacco Honey Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Tobacco Honey is the French house's entry into tobacco fragrances, and it sidesteps every cliché in the category. The tobacco is not raw or smoky. It is a custom synthetic accord built by perfumer Delphine Jelk, golden and smooth, wrapped in warm honey and tonka. Polarizing for buyers who expect a rugged tobacco leaf scent. Built for autumn evenings, intimate dinners, and cold-weather formal occasions.

products.title: Riiffs Seasons Drift Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Seasons Drift is Riiffs' woody aromatic take on Bleu de Chanel L'Exclusif. Same citrus-pepper top, same resinous amber backbone. Where the original is known for fading fast, Seasons Drift pushes harder on skin. Reviewers consistently report six hours at medium-to-strong strength. Polished without being safe. Built for office mornings, casual weekends, and everything in between.

products.title: Riiffs Seasons Rise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Seasons Rise is Riiffs' floral gourmand take on Emporio Armani's Stronger With You Parfum. Toffee, caramel, and cinnamon run through both, but Seasons Rise leans sweeter and more dessert-forward. Fresh bottles need four to eight weeks of shelf rest before the scent fully settles. Best for autumn and winter evenings, dates, and anything after dark.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Parfum is the 2024 upgrade to one of Tom Ford's most wearable warm-weather florals. The Parfum concentration uses a total fruit extraction of winter-harvested bergamot, pulling richer, sweeter citrus out of the peel than the original EDP ever managed. Bright and creamy without tipping into heavy. Built for office mornings, weekend lunches, and anything from spring through early autumn.

products.title: Giorgio Armani My Way Sunny Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani My Way Sunny Vanilla is the 2025 addition to the My Way line, built on a floral-fruity structure anchored by traceable Madagascar vanilla. The vanilla is ethically sourced from the Sava region through Armani's partnership with NGO Fanamby, not a generic synthetic. Bright and warm without tipping into gourmand. Best for spring and summer daywear, casual brunches, and warm-weather evenings.

products.title: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum is Giorgio Armani's floral fruity gourmand for women, built around passionfruit and Madagascar vanilla with frangipani in the middle. It was co-created by two named Givaudan perfumers, which is unusual for a designer release at this price point. Tropical without tipping into sugary, warm without getting heavy. Best for spring and summer days, casual dinners, and anything outdoors.

products.title: Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu is Azzaro's boldest move in the oriental woody space. The opening runs two forms of incense at once, oil and resinoid. A structural choice rarely seen at this price point. Underneath sits a whiskey-milk-vanilla core that feels dark and warm, not sweet. Polarizing on first spray, not built for subtlety. Evening, date nights, cold weather only.

products.title: Mykonos Reflection Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Reflection Extrait de Parfum is a faithful take on Louis Vuitton's Symphony, from the Indonesian house Mykonos. It carries the same bright citrus-floral structure, but at Extrait concentration, so the peach and jasmine linger well past where the original starts to thin out. Cheerful without being shallow. Clean without going generic. Built for spring and summer daytime, from the office to weekend brunches.

products.title: Mykonos Pink Drops Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Pink Drops Extrait de Parfum is the Indonesian gourmand label Mykonos betting everything on strawberry milk. Built at extrait concentration, the same oil load niche houses use at five times the price. The sweetness stays put instead of vanishing in an hour. Divisive on first spray. Too sugary for some, addictive for others. Best for casual outings, cooler days, or anywhere the AC is doing its job.

products.title: Mykonos Café Drops Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Café Drops Extrait de Parfum is the oriental vanilla from Mykonos that refuses to stay in the dessert lane. The coffee accord opens alongside orchid and jasmine, not after them. That timing pulls the whole thing away from standard gourmand into something roasted and lush at once. Sweet but not simple, warm but not drowsy. Built for cool-weather evenings, layered knits, and slow weekends.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Oud Al Layl Midnight Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Oud Al Layl Midnight Edition is a marine-citrus take on Paco Rabanne Invictus from Arabiyat Prestige's Middle Eastern lineup. Despite sharing a name with the rose-saffron-oud original, the Midnight Edition drops that DNA entirely for a fresh aquatic blue structure. One of the rare budget options that opens Mediterranean rather than Middle Eastern. Built for Indian summers, daytime wear, and casual evenings where heat demands something that cuts through.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Ignite Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Ignite Oud is a green-leather take on Maison Crivelli's Oud Maracujá, from one of the more talked-about Middle Eastern houses. Despite the name, there's almost no detectable oud. The real backbone is geranium and patchouli wrapped in a cool leather accord, making it far more approachable than it sounds. Evening-leaning, best in cooler months, built for nights where showing up matters.

products.title: Nusuk Amber Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Amber Oud Eau de Parfum is Nusuk's take on Lancôme's Oud Bouquet, built on the same rose-oud-vanilla backbone at a fraction of the price. What sets it apart is how close it stays to the skin. Sweet, smoky, and gourmand, but never loud. One of the few oud-ambers that works as a daily wear. Best for autumn and winter evenings, or any cooler day when a quiet oriental feels right.

products.title: Riiffs Bleu Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bleu Absolu is a sharp, citrus-forward take on Dior Sauvage EDP from UAE-based house Riiffs. Where most budget alternatives lean heavy on pepper and ambroxan, Bleu Absolu builds its base around Iso E Super, a synthetic woody molecule that smells like clean, airy cedar. Less brute-force than the original, more transparent. Built for daytime, warm weather, and offices where restraint counts.

products.title: Riiffs Café Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Café Noir Eau de Parfum is Riiffs' aromatic fougère take on Paco Rabanne's Black XS. Despite the dark name, this one skews fresh and marine. The seawater and geranium heart push it further into aquatic territory than the original ever goes. More breezy than brooding, more cologne-adjacent than clubwear. Built for office days, casual outings, and anywhere the AC is running.

products.title: Riiffs Cuir Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Cuir Imperial is one of the more interesting leather fragrances in Riiffs' lineup. It wears nothing like its "for women" label suggests. The leather-tobacco base is closer to a classic masculine chypre than a feminine oriental. Citrus and lavender keep the top half clean. Marketed for women, worn by anyone. Best for autumn and winter evenings, formal dinners, and cooler-month office wear.

products.title: Riiffs Rosa Femme Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rosa Femme Extrait de Parfum is Riiffs' take on Parfums de Marly's Cassili, built on the same lychee-rose-peony core at a fraction of the price. The difference is in the base. Cashmeran adds a velvety, skin-close warmth that most budget florals never bother with. Feminine without being sugary, structured without feeling stiff. Works from office mornings through dinner, especially in spring and autumn.

products.title: Riiffs Avant Garde Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Avant Garde is Riiffs' take on Prada L'Homme, the powdery iris-amber office staple from 2016. The original plays it cool and clean from the first spray. Avant Garde leads with a sharper citrus-pepper-cardamom push that wakes the iris heart up. Powdery without feeling flat. More energetic than the Prada, less expensive by a wide margin. Built for office hours, cooler months, and daily rotation.

products.title: Riiffs Melissa Poudree Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Melissa Poudree Eau de Parfum is Riiffs' take on Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudree, built on the same powdery musk-and-floral spine. What sets it apart is a caramelised, beeswax-like sweetness in the base. Coumarin and almond sit just beneath the musk, adding warmth the original keeps at arm's length. Soft rather than loud, feminine without being delicate. Best for autumn and winter evenings, or as a skin-close daily wear when the weather cools.

products.title: Riiffs Masculin Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Masculin Leather Eau de Parfum is Riiffs' fruity-chypre take on Creed Aventus, built on the same pineapple-birch-oakmoss backbone. Despite "Leather" in the name, there is no leather note. Birch smoke and oakmoss create the dry, leathery edge while keeping the Aventus DNA intact. More wearable than loud. Best for autumn and winter evenings, sturdy enough to carry from office to dinner.

products.title: Riiffs Tanzanite Bronze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Tanzanite Bronze is Riiffs' budget take on Bvlgari Le Gemme Empyr. Both share a stripped-back four-note structure, ginger layered over ginger, drying into sandalwood and labdanum. The original runs well above ₹20,000. This gets close for a fraction of that. Warm but clean, woody but light. Works year-round, office through dinner, without ever feeling out of place.

products.title: Riiffs Tanzanite Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Tanzanite Amber Eau de Parfum borrows from two playbooks at once. Community reviewers place it between the Aventus Cologne profile and Sauvage EDP, making it a rare dual-reference fragrance from Riiffs at a fraction of either price. Floral and amber-heavy, more layered than loud. Best for autumn and winter evenings. Less convincing in peak heat.

products.title: Riiffs Bella Rouge Intenso Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bella Rouge Intenso is Riiffs' take on YSL Libre Intense, built on the same honeysuckle-and-vanilla backbone but pushing the florals louder. Community reviewers consistently report it lasting longer than the original. Six to nine hours on skin, even longer on fabric. Warm and full without tipping into syrupy. Best for autumn evenings, date nights, and cooler weather after dark.

products.title: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette is the British house's entry into the woody-spicy category for men, built around a cedarwood base that pulls oils from three mountain ranges. Atlas, Virginian, and Himalayan cedar give the base a layered, geographic depth rare at this price. Clean and structured, never loud. Best for office days, casual weekends, and warm-weather months where a lighter presence fits.

products.title: Chloe Nomade Lumiere d'Egypte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Egypte Eau de Parfum is the Nomade line's most layered release yet, rooted in ancient Egyptian perfumery. The base draws on kyphi, one of the earliest recorded perfume formulas, built from cinnamon bark, sandalwood, and myrrh. Floral and resinous rather than sweet or heavy. More contemplative than the original Nomade. Best for spring and summer daytime, casual through smart-casual.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Valero Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Valero Extrait de Parfum is the first release from Parfums De Marly's new Les Extraits collection, landing squarely in woody fougère territory. Crisp juniper and cedrat up front, a lavender-geranium core stiffened with cypress, then a patchouli-sandalwood base held together by Ambrox. Herbal and structured, not sweet. More boardroom than bar. Best for office days, smart-casual outings, and warm-weather daytime wear.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Carios Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Carios Extrait de Parfum is the flagship release from Parfums de Marly's new Les Extraits tier and their first real swing at an ambery fougère. Saffron runs through the entire wear, leathery and dry, backed by red thyme and black pepper that keep it herbal rather than sweet. More confrontational than crowd-pleasing. Built for cold evenings, formal dinners, and rooms where subtlety reads as confidence.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Eragon Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Eragon Extrait de Parfum is the French house's 2025 entry into dense, oriental woody territory. Spiced citrus up front gives way to a cinnamon-davana warmth on leather and vanilla, without tipping sweet. Rich but controlled. More whispered flex than loud entrance. Built for autumn and winter evenings, black-tie dinners, and occasions that call for weight.

products.title: Tauer No. 02 L'Air du Désert Marocain Eau de Toilette Intense
products.body_html: L'Air du Désert Marocain Eau de Toilette Intense is the fragrance that built Tauer Perfumes, handmade in small batches in Zurich by a self-taught perfumer. The base runs on a synthetic ambergris accord, not conventional amber, so it finishes mineral and saline rather than sweet. Divisive on first wear. Rewarding on the tenth. Built for cold, dry evenings when skin warmth does the work.

products.title: Matière Première Santal Austral Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Santal Austral is Matière Première's single-ingredient showcase, built around certified organic Australian sandalwood by seventh-generation Grasse perfumer Aurélien Guichard. The sandalwood here is dry and earthy, not the creamy, sweetened version most houses default to. Quietly structured, never loud. Stays close to the skin. Best for office days, cool-weather evenings, and layering.

products.title: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Rose Chérie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Rose Chérie is the French house's most layered rose, built on four distinct rose varieties sourced from Bulgaria, Turkey, and Grasse. Perfumer Delphine Jelk stacks rose water, rose absolute, and rose oil against raspberry and almond. The result sits between fresh-cut garden and warm patisserie. Feminine without being fragile. Best for spring and autumn days, date nights, and moments that call for quiet richness.

products.title: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Oud Nude Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Oud Nude is Guerlain's attempt to make oud feel quiet. The Bangladeshi oud here is stripped of its usual animalic weight, leaving something luminous and skin-close. More warm sandalwood and almond than anything heavy. Gentle enough to wear without warning, but still unmistakably oud. Best for autumn evenings, intimate dinners, and cooler nights where subtlety carries further than volume.

products.title: Rayhaan Azul Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Azul is Rayhaan's take on Dior Homme Cologne, built as an aromatic aquatic with the same stripped-back citrus-and-skin structure. Only five notes in the pyramid, so every ingredient pulls weight. Lean and transparent rather than layered. Not for anyone who wants complexity. Built for scorching Indian summers, gym bags, and office air conditioning.

products.title: Decant Case
products.body_html:
The SCENTIRA decant case keeps your fragrance protected, portable, and stylish. A sturdy aluminium shell shields the refillable glass vial from sunlight, breakage, and evaporation, while the leak-resistant twist-and-spray top makes reapplying effortless. Choose your size and colour to match how you carry your scent.

Sizes:

  • 5ml — minimal carry for quick outings, pocket touch-ups, and sampling new scents.
  • 10ml — 100+ sprays for office days, weekend travel, and rotating signature scents.
  • 20ml — 200+ sprays for extended travel, long workweeks, and dedicated signature-scent wearers.

products.title: Versace Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Versace’s most iconic masculine fragrances — a fresh minty legend, a fiery spicy signature, and a crisp aquatic woody scent. Three miniatures that showcase the bold, energetic style of the house before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Versace Eros EDT is mint, green apple, and lemon over tonka bean, ambroxan, and geranium, settling into Madagascar vanilla, cedarwood, vetiver, and oakmoss — fresh, sweet, and undeniably seductive.

• Versace Eros Flame is mandarin, black pepper, rosemary, and chinotto over pepperwood, geranium, and rose, settling into tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, and oakmoss — spicy, bold, and passionately masculine.

• Versace Eau Fraîche Extreme is lemon, bergamot, and cardamom over sage, cedarwood, and pepper, settling into musk, amber, and woody notes — clean, vibrant, and effortlessly refreshing.

Three Versace icons, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your signature Versace fragrance.

products.title: Date Night Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three irresistible fragrances made for unforgettable evenings — a sweet gourmand icon, a smooth whiskey-chestnut masterpiece, and a fiery spicy fresh signature. Three miniatures that capture the warmth, confidence, and sensuality of the perfect date night.

Inside:

• Stronger With You Intensely is pink pepper, violet, and juniper over lavender, sage, and cinnamon, settling into vanilla, amber wood, and chestnut accords — sweet, spicy, and addictive.

• Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privée is bergamot over iris and chestnut, settling into whiskey accord, cedarwood, amber, and patchouli — smooth, boozy, and effortlessly sophisticated.

• Versace Eros Flame is mandarin, black pepper, and rosemary over pepperwood, geranium, and rose, settling into tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, and oakmoss — bold, passionate, and irresistibly masculine.

Three date-night favorites, one unforgettable set — the perfect way to discover your next evening signature.

products.title: Riiffs Beast Mode Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has five of Riiffs' boldest creations — a rich oriental blend, a refined modern woody scent, a powerful oud signature, and two luxurious amber elixirs. Five miniatures that showcase the house's most intense and statement-making fragrances before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Desert de Sahara is citrus and warm spices over saffron, rose, and woody accords, settling into amber, oud, and musk — rich, exotic, and captivating.

• Momento is bergamot and aromatic spices over lavender, cedarwood, and patchouli, settling into amber, vetiver, and musk — fresh, refined, and confidently masculine.

• Goodness Oud Black is saffron and spices over rose, oud, and patchouli, settling into amber, vanilla, and musk — dark, bold, and irresistibly luxurious.

• Golden Elixir is citrus and spicy notes over amber, woods, and floral accords, settling into vanilla, musk, and sandalwood — warm, smooth, and elegant.

• Golden Elixir Reserve is bergamot and spices over amberwood and cedar, settling into vanilla, musk, and precious woods — rich, sophisticated, and long-lasting.

Five beast-mode favorites, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover Riiffs' most powerful and luxurious signatures.

products.title: Best of Khadlaj Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has five of Khadlaj’s most popular modern releases — a fresh woody signature, a rich amber scent, a bold masculine fragrance, an elegant oriental blend, and a creamy vanilla gourmand. Five miniatures that showcase the diversity of the house before going full bottle.

Inside:

  • Shiyaaka Snow is a fresh citrus and woody composition with soft musky undertones — clean, refined, and highly versatile.

  • Onyx Gold is an amber-woody fragrance with warm oriental character — rich, luxurious, and captivating.

  • Titan is a modern aromatic woody scent with fresh spices and warm amber nuances — bold, confident, and masculine.

  • Zayaan Gold is a smooth oriental blend with woody and musky facets — warm, elegant, and sophisticated.

  • Vanilla Dunes is a creamy vanilla gourmand with soft woody depth — sweet, addictive, and comforting.

Five Khadlaj favorites, one exceptional set — the perfect way to explore the brand’s most loved signatures.

products.title: Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ingenious Ginger is the fragrance that made Goldfield & Banks a talking point outside the woody-coastal lane they're known for. The ginger here isn't spicy or culinary. It's built around a custom accord imagining the Australian Red Back Ginger Flower, a bloom with no natural fragrance. Floral and warm, not sharp. Best for spring and summer, especially in humid weather.

products.title: Penhaligon's Changing Constance Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Changing Constance Eau de Parfum is the sharpest gourmand in Penhaligon's Portraits collection. The tobacco here works as a savoury Turkish cigar accord, not a sweet background note, and that changes the whole shape of the fragrance. Salted caramel and cardamom up front, then cashmeran and vanilla underneath, kept dry by the tobacco. More intimate than loud. Best for autumn evenings, winter dates, and anywhere the mood is close and unhurried.

products.title: Guerlain L'Art & La Matière Spiritueuse Double Vanille Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Spiritueuse Double Vanille Eau de Parfum is Guerlain's proof that vanilla can be serious. From the L'Art & La Matière collection, it uses Madagascan planifolia cold-soaked for eighteen months. That tincture method strips the sweetness and leaves something woody, resinous, almost smoky. Closer to incense than dessert. Built for autumn and winter evenings, especially the intimate ones.

products.title: Rayhaan Wolf Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Wolf Eau de Parfum is Rayhaan's take on Azzaro The Most Wanted EDP Intense, built on the same toffee-cardamom sweetness and warm amberwood base. Community consensus puts the base notes at near-identical to the original, with slightly stronger throw at a fraction of the cost. Sweet and warm, not juvenile. Best for date nights, cooler evenings, and anywhere a compliment or two won't hurt.

Inside:

• Green Irish Tweed is lemon verbena and iris over violet leaf, settling into sandalwood, ambergris, and musk — fresh, elegant, and timeless.

Three Creed masterpieces, one classic set — the perfect way to discover the house’s most celebrated signatures.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Orage Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Orage Eau de Parfum is Louis Vuitton's attempt to bottle petrichor. The woody base, built on Java vetiver oil and Iso E Super, amplifies the ozonic freshness rather than grounding it. The whole thing smells like wet earth right before a storm. Reviewers consistently say nothing else on the market does this. More atmospheric than clean, more textured than sharp. Built for daytime across spring, summer, and autumn.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Raees Aurum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Raees Aurum is a faithful oriental-fruity take on Xerjoff's Erba Gold, from the Middle Eastern house Arabiyat Prestige. Bright pear and citrus up front, warm sandalwood-vanilla underneath. The 180ml bottle gives triple the volume of the Xerjoff at a fraction of the cost. Value that's hard to argue with. Light enough for daytime, warm enough for casual evenings through spring and summer.

products.title: Mykonos Sorrento Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mykonos Sorrento Extrait de Parfum is a faithful take on Sospiro Vibrato, from the Indonesian house Mykonos.
